svg.title: Awaken: streaming model tower
svg.desc: Three representative steps share a causal audio encoder, a three-input fusion layer, transformer backbone, audio decoder, and CosyVoice detokenizer above. Each input group contains user features, text, and five audio codes. Hidden states predict text and condition audio generation; a feedback path connects generated text and audio to the next step.

g.text: Three representative streaming steps · 200 ms per step · information flows upward
Audio decoder · hidden state + current text + speech history
Fusion layer · user features + text/audio embeddings
Right-side feedback: generated text and audio join fresh user features at the next step.
The decoder uses current text and speech history; sampled next text enters the following backbone step.
The system / role prefix is prefilled into the backbone cache. Waveforms and tokens are illustrative.
